# The 8% is not what they take. The checkout total is.

> Free Whatnot seller fee calculator. Commission on the hammer, processing on the checkout total (item + shipping + tax) plus $0.30, the $1,500 TCG cap, leftover after the label, and whether free shipping is cheaper. Nothing leaves your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
